composition: vertical strip with flanking disc elements
description: Mixed-media collage on worn white paper featuring a central vertical strip with hand-drawn imagery including a heart, sun rays, and figures, anchored by a side-view warplane silhouette with red accents. Three compact discs flank the composition, alongside a green panel with snowman motifs and a pink collage element below.
title: Untitled (Plane and Discs)
